pr_title: Make resolver GetTypeInfo methods return new instances on every call
pr_comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-text-json, @gregsdennis See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/76535.
Author: layomia
Assignees: layomia
Labels: `area-System.Text.Json`
Milestone: 7.0.0

> Update the implementation of JsonSerializers's [JsonSerializerContext resolution logic](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/656eafb92253b44ec375d933cc16fa3a46885a8f/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/src/System/Text/Json/Serialization/JsonSerializer.Helpers.cs#L42-L55) so that metadata is looked up via the JsonSerializerOptions cache.

On that note, it appears that this approach has the potential of interacting with the [reflection fallback compatibility switch](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/75615) that was recently added. TL;DR if the compatibility switch is enabled, it would most likely result in reflection metadata leaking into `JsonSerializerContext` serialization methods -- a regression from .NET 6.

@layomia I pushed commit https://github.com/eiriktsarpalis/runtime/commit/240a24c3df13eb14dd3e49605836c2695138e498 in my fork of your PR branch which demonstrate how we could keep using cached metadata in the `JsonSerializerContext` serialization overloads without regressing any functional tests. PTAL and incorporate in your PR as necessary.

> On that note, it appears that this approach has the potential of interacting with the https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/75615 that was recently added. TL;DR if the compatibility switch is enabled, it would most likely result in reflection metadata leaking into JsonSerializerContext serialization methods -- a regression from .NET 6.

Yeah can confirm this happens; I noticed reflection-fallback test failures in an earlier iteration of this PR when taking this approach.

> @layomia I pushed commit https://github.com/eiriktsarpalis/runtime/commit/240a24c3df13eb14dd3e49605836c2695138e498 in my fork of your PR branch which demonstrate how we could keep using cached metadata in the JsonSerializerContext serialization overloads without regressing any functional tests. PTAL and incorporate in your PR as necessary.

I agree this would be the right way to mitigate the performance hit from this change were we to go down the path this PR proposes. But the solution in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/76540 is more complete and less breaking so I'll close this in favor of that approach.

issue_context.title: Contract metadata cached by the source generator are user-modifiable.
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-text-json, @gregsdennis See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
That would be this: ```cs JsonTypeInfo typeInfo = SourceGenContext.Default.Person; foreach (JsonPropertyInfo property in typeInfo.Properties) { property.Name = property.Name.ToUpperInvariant(); } string json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(person, typeInfo); // Fail: regular-case is serialized instead (because fast-path is taken; metadata should be used instead since we have it). JsonTestHelper.AssertJsonEqual(@"{""FIRSTNAME"":""Jane"",""LASTNAME"":""Doe""}", json); Person person = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(json, typeInfo); Assert.Equal("Jane", person.FirstName); Assert.Equal("Doe", person.LastName); ``` _Originally posted by @layomia in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/76531#discussion_r985752435_
Author: eiriktsarpalis
Assignees: -
Labels: `area-System.Text.Json`, `untriaged`
Milestone: -
This is only true until first usage. Make sure to test recursive types here if we decide to fix this. Also I think only .Default JsonTypeInfos should be locked

There's another issue: making the instances mutable effectively breaks fast-path delegate invalidation so you can end up with inconsistent serialization outputs. This was the original issue highlighted by @layomia's repro:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/76531#discussion_r985752435
